headline: Transfer rumors, news: Liverpool eye Ismaïla Sarr move in January
description: The transfer window may be over, but that hasn't stopped clubs doing business. Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: City squeeze past Coventry behind Haaland's winner
description: Erling Haaland's first-half header sees Manchester City edge out Coventry 1-0 to make it three wins from three to start their Premier League campaign.

headline: Mikel Arteta confident that Bukayo Saka can take his game to 'different level' at Arsenal
description: Mikel Arteta has praised Bukayo Saka's determination to take his game to a new level during Arsenal's Premier League title defence.

headline: Haaland outpaces Ronaldo, Mbappé to 300 club goals
description: Erling Haaland scored the 300th goal of his club career as Man City extended their 100% start by beating Coventry 1-0 to stay at the top of the Premier League.

headline: Carrick: Man United 'can compete' with Premier League rivals despite spending less
description: Michael Carrick insists Manchester United can compete with their Premier League rivals this season despite being out-spent in the transfer market.

headline: Robson: I cannot see Chelsea beating Arsenal this early in the season
description: Robson: I cannot see Chelsea beating Arsenal this early in the season
